title: qwen-chat deployment diagram
description: How qwen-chat runs: a binary built with cargo and started from a terminal, which keeps the model weights in a cache folder on the same machine and fetches them once from Hugging Face.

nodes.name: Developer's terminal
nodes.description: Types messages and reads the streamed replies, or pipes a question in.

nodes.name: The developer's computer
nodes.description: A Mac (Metal) or a Linux machine (CPU) with about 7 GB of free memory for the 9B model.

nodes.name: qwen-chat
nodes.description: One chat session or one-shot question; the model runs inside this process.

nodes.name: Weights cache
nodes.description: Qwen3.5-9B-Q4_K_M.gguf (5.7 GB) in $QWEN_CHAT_HOME, ~/Library/Caches/qwen-chat on macOS, or $XDG_CACHE_HOME/qwen-chat (~/.cache/qwen-chat) elsewhere.

nodes.name: huggingface.co
nodes.condition: Only while the weights are missing and --model is not given.

artifacts.name: qwen-chat
artifacts.description: Built with cargo build --release -p qwen-chat; not yet in the release tarball or the Homebrew formula.

relationships.description: Runs the binary as the calling user.
A folder in the user's home or the one QWEN_CHAT_HOME names.
Messages on stdin, answers on stdout, progress, reasoning in one-shot mode and errors on stderr.
Writes the .part file while downloading, then memory-maps the weights.
HTTPS GET with a Range header to resume; checks SHA-256 before use.
